derived_by: dirtyloader.re.portmap from Model:02 6.6.2A and Headless 6.6.4A, each address checked by hand (docs/MODEL02-664-PORT.md)

BOOT.strategy: detour the call; run BOOT handlers after setup() returns, once
BOOT.note: fires a single time, right before the main loop begins

TICK.strategy: detour the call; run TICK handlers each frame, then call loop()
TICK.note: loop is a b.w veneer to 0x6008646C, which runs the touch engine (0x60086008) and goes on to the loop body at 0x60086294

notes: loop (0x60085368) is a b.w veneer, as on headless; yield (main's bl 0x600BAF30) is an ldr.w pc veneer to ITCM 0x2BACD.

6.6.4A Model:02 is built like Headless 6.6.4A where 6.6.2A Model:02 was not: the audio engine is one object (0x2000C780, a function-local static built by 0x6009D9D4) reached through a pointer, set_view reads a 30-slot view table (0x20000BD8), players are 0x248 apart. Its Model:02 parts (touch, the visualizer, the right-hand column, 32-frame audio blocks, the track strips' class) follow 6.6.2A Model:02.

settings_row.note: the same template as 6.6.2A Model:02 (BATT.CHARGING row 20, FIRMWARE UPDATE row 21, 14 fields): the MODS row goes in row 22, field 14. 0x60078150/58 hold the template, 0x60078934 the colours (template + 0x3C4)

loader.note: core 0.7 for Model:02 6.6.4A: free flash past the image (ends 0x601F1400) up to the EEPROM emulation at 0x60FC0000; the ITCM tail after the firmware's ITCM code (0x2BFB0, 16.3 KB to 0x2FF80). No view_switch: set_view reads a view table (slot 7 empty), as on headless. load_at is the bl 0x600A07AC in setup() right after the card is mounted (bl 0x60080604 at 0x60085A3E): its first call builds the audio engine, as at headless's load_at.

BOOT.note: main: bl setup; 6.6.2A Model:02 and Headless both map here

KEY.note: loop body: read the input (0x6007EA64), then bl input router(ui 0x2001BD34, action); the router stores millis at ui+8 and toggles the visualizer on 0xE4, as 6.6.2A's 0x6004C6C8
